site.sitedescription: Dunbar Lake lies in unconsolidated till and probably originated as an ice block depression (kettle lake). Surrounding vegetation: Lodgepole pine, Douglas fir, white spurce, and trembling aspen. The understory is dominated by Shpherdia canadensis, Amelanchier, Rosa acicularis, Mahonia repens, Cornus canadensis, Arctostaphylos uva-ursi, and Epilopbium angustifolium.
